data.name: Variant Channeling - Beauty/Love/Lust
data.description: Heal - Creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on saving throws against charm effects and abilities based on fascination or physical attractiveness (such as a nymph's blinding beauty and stunning glance abilities) for 1 minute. Harm - Creatures gain a -%1 channel penalty on saving throws against charm effects and effects that fascinate for 1 minute.|ChannelModifier
